purpose: C6-A0 channel inventory, C6-A1 frozen-candidate fusion replay infrastructure, and the complete preregistration of C6-A2/A3 policies, cohorts, metrics, gates, and decision rules. This artifact contains no C6-A2 relevance outcome; no policy was executed on Gold relevance.

current_production_channel_roles.semantic_dense: auxiliary/shadow; production efficacy UNVALIDATED; final role owned by C6

c6_a0_inventory.primary_source_decision: phase-b-t3-retrieval-20260816 is the single homogeneous core source: the newest complete 80-case dev retrieval run with all six production channels recorded per case (channel_candidates with object_id/rank/score/channels/source/version/locator) and recorded fused order+scores. b5/a3 runs cover case subsets of t3 with the same trace schema and were used as cross-checks only; combining per-case streams across runs was unnecessary for core replay.

missing_vs_empty_rule.paper_channel: PRESENT_EMPTY when the trace has no paper key: the production source always executes _paper and only omits empty results from the rankings dict, so absence of the key in an otherwise complete trace records an explicitly-executed empty channel.
missing_vs_empty_rule.semantic_dense_channel: MISSING_NOT_CAPTURED for the 75 t3 cases without any captured semantic stream (SemanticDense did not exist in the t3 execution path).

trace_version_and_source_safety.cross_run_semantic_compatibility: C3-A resume semantic streams (5 cases) were combined with t3 core streams only because the C3-A raw_dense top-20 was verified object-identical (order included) to the t3 dense stream for every one of the 5 cases (same question text, same index fingerprint, same embedding model, filter-equivalent results), so compatibility is established without guessing.

current_production_fusion_identity.formula: fused_score(object) = sum over enabled channels of channel_weight / (60 + 1-based channel rank)
current_production_fusion_identity.rank_convention: channel candidates are 0-based enumerated in production and divided by (60 + rank + 1), identical to 1-based ranks over RRF_K=60; trace candidates carry 1-based ranks
current_production_fusion_identity.candidate_limits: policies.candidate_pool_per_channel per channel (frozen traces already reflect it); fused pool top-30 recorded
current_production_fusion_identity.deduplication: object_id string identity (production scores dict keyed by object_id)
current_production_fusion_identity.tie_breaking: Python stable sort over the insertion-ordered score map: equal-score objects keep production dict-insertion order (channel iteration order exact->dense->sparse->paper->workflow->graph, then first-seen candidate order)
current_production_fusion_identity.empty_or_skipped_channels: empty channels contribute nothing (production omits empty paper results from the rankings dict); there is no plan-level channel skip in the current production path

c6_a1_replay_implementation.module: src/panda_agent/fusion_replay.py (pure, evaluation-only; production retrieval does not import it; import scan confirms no psycopg/QdrantClient/VertexAIClient/requests usage)
c6_a1_replay_implementation.candidate_identity: object_id, matching production fusion semantics exactly
c6_a1_replay_implementation.channel_name_mapping: historical trace channel 'dense' is replayed as the C6 authoritative channel 'raw_dense'
c6_a1_replay_implementation.fusion_receipt_contents: final fused rank, fused score, contributing channels, per-channel rank/weight/contribution, channel count, unique-channel flag, expansion pool for P5, policy id/version, case id, enabled channels
c6_a1_replay_implementation.p5_expansion_semantics: CURRENT scored ranking is recomputed identically and never altered by semantic_dense; semantic-only unique candidates are appended to an explicit expansion pool in semantic rank order

parity_evidence.cross_check_runs: b5-pre (16/16), b5-post (16/16), generalization-a3-stratified-retrieval (24/24) also reproduce order+score exactly with the CURRENT parameters, confirming those runs share the production fusion identity
parity_evidence.comparison_target: historical pre-reranker fused candidate order and recorded fusion scores (fused_candidates); reranked output and selected evidence were never compared

P1_RAW_DENSE_CENTERED.delta: raw_dense weight = 1.5 x CURRENT (1.5); all other CURRENT weights unchanged; semantic_dense disabled

P2_EXACT_HEAVY.delta: exact weight = 1.5 x CURRENT (3.0); all other CURRENT weights unchanged; semantic_dense disabled

P3_SPARSE_HEAVY.delta: sparse weight = 1.5 x CURRENT (1.5); all other CURRENT weights unchanged; semantic_dense disabled

P4_SEMANTIC_AUXILIARY_25.delta: dense-family total weight preserved: raw_dense = 0.75 x CURRENT (0.75), semantic_dense = 0.25 x CURRENT (0.25); all non-dense CURRENT weights unchanged

P5_SEMANTIC_EXPANSION_ONLY.delta: CURRENT scored fusion unchanged; semantic_dense contributes no weighted-RRF score and may only append unique candidates to an explicit expansion pool in semantic rank order; evaluated primarily for candidate-union recall and unique relevant contribution, not as an ordinary weighted fused-ranking policy

CORE_POLICY_COHORT.rule: maximum 30 cases selected deterministically when more are available: within each intent sort case IDs ascending, then round-robin one case per intent in the fixed repository intent cycle (installation, usage, algorithm_theory, algorithm_implementation, api, data_flow, module_structure, troubleshooting) until 30 cases are reached; selection uses only structural replay availability and never inspects relevance
CORE_POLICY_COHORT.if_below_12: A2 may run diagnostics only; production-policy selection evidence is insufficient

SEMANTIC_POLICY_COHORT.rule: all SEMANTIC_REPLAY cases up to 20, deterministic by intent + case ID
SEMANTIC_POLICY_COHORT.current_status: 5 available < 8 minimum -> semantic_a2_evidence_eligible = false; the SemanticDense production-role decision must remain EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT unless a separately authorized candidate-coverage task expands the frozen semantic cohort

INTENT_DIAGNOSTIC_REPLAY.rule: CORE_POLICY_COHORT cases with faithful intent labels; an intent is SUFFICIENTLY_REPRESENTED only if >=4 CORE_POLICY_COHORT cases carry it; intents below 4 are descriptive only and cannot drive C6-A3 intent-aware policy construction; unrelated intents are never merged to satisfy counts

NOVEL_REPLAY.rule: no novel data may be created inside C6

aggregate_per_policy: critical evidence coverage where Gold supports it
per_intent: same core ranking metrics where intent sample size is sufficient

preregistered_global_policy_safety_gates: 8 no version/source violation introduced by replay
gate_notes: MRR and Recall@5 are required diagnostics; a materially lower MRR requires explicit review even if the hard recall gates pass; no new gate may be defined after A2.

novel_corroboration_gate.rule: a new production fusion policy must not be activated solely because it wins on the exposed Gold development cohort; if trustworthy human-authored NOVEL_REPLAY data existed, corroboration would be required (no Recall@10/20 regression, no new critical miss, no obvious policy-direction reversal)
novel_corroboration_gate.consequence: NEW_PRODUCTION_POLICY_ACTIVATION = NOT_AUTHORIZED_BY_C6_A2_ALONE; C6-A3 must either retain CURRENT production fusion or remain INCONCLUSIVE pending independent corroboration; no novel data may be created inside C6 to bypass this gate

preregistered_semanticdense_decision_tre.meaningful_marginal_recall_condition: N_sem >= 8 AND semantic_unique_relevant_case_count >= max(2, ceil(0.10 * N_sem))
preregistered_semanticdense_decision_tre.if_condition_fails: SemanticDense production role = KEEP_DISABLED (lack of contribution) or EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT (lack of cohort coverage)
preregistered_semanticdense_decision_tre.if_meaningful_and_P4_passes_all_global_g: C6-A3 may consider SemanticDense weighted production participation
preregistered_semanticdense_decision_tre.if_meaningful_but_P4_harms_ranking_while: C6-A3 may consider SemanticDense = CANDIDATE_EXPANSION_ONLY, subject to downstream compatibility and novel corroboration
preregistered_semanticdense_decision_tre.current_cohort_consequence: with 5 semantic cases (<8), the SemanticDense decision defaults to EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT regardless of A2 diagnostics

eligibility_conditions: 1 at least 3 intents SUFFICIENTLY_REPRESENTED (>=4 CORE_POLICY_COHORT cases each)
3 at least 2 sufficiently represented intents show different preferred preregistered global policy families
4 a preferred policy for an intent must improve Fused Recall@10 or MRR relative to CURRENT without reducing Recall@20 and without a new critical miss
6 preference must derive from a preregistered global policy, never a newly invented weight combination
preregistered_intent_aware_rules.if_not_met: intent_aware = NOT_JUSTIFIED and C6-A3 must not create one
preregistered_intent_aware_rules.construction_rule: C6_INTENT_AWARE_V1 maps each sufficiently represented intent to one preregistered global policy by deterministic priority: highest Fused Recall@10, then highest Recall@20, then highest MRR, then prefer CURRENT; intents without sufficient evidence use CURRENT; no new weight vectors, no per-intent weight tuning

c6_a3_may: activate one preregistered global policy (subject to the novel corroboration gate)

selection_layer_debt_rule: If C6-A2 shows relevant evidence well-ranked in the fused pool but removed by reranker/selector, record downstream rerank/selection debt; do not alter fusion to compensate. C7 owns evidence-selection constraints; C8 owns targeted-retrieval global merge/rerank.

a2_eligibility.semantic_reason: SEMANTIC_POLICY_COHORT = 5 < 8 minimum; A2 may evaluate core policies but must not make a substantive SemanticDense production claim

zero_live_call_ledger.production_behavior: UNCHANGED (fusion_replay.py is evaluation-only and not imported by production retrieval)

known_limitations: semantic_dense frozen coverage is 5 cases, below the preregistered substantive-evidence minimum of 8
novel corroboration data is ABSENT, so no new production fusion policy may be activated by C6-A2 alone
